name: Antaeus
body:
Antaeus CR 5

This broad-shouldered humanoid has rippling musculature, his dark skin gleaming as if oiled. He has a full beard, shaggy hair, and a haughty mien.

XP 2,400
N Medium humanoid (earth, giant)
Init +2; Senses Perception +2

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 12, flat-footed 13 (+3 armor, +2 Dex)
hp 60 (6d8+36); regeneration 20 (see Gaea’s vitality)
Fort +10, Ref +3, Will +1
Defensive Abilities counter-throw

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee fist +12/+7 (1d8+6 plus grab)
Special Attacks sucker punch

STATISTICS

Str 22, Dex 14, Con 22, Int 10, Wis 10, Cha 12
Base Atk +6; CMB +12 (+20 grapple, +22 grapple vs. humanoids); CMD 24 (26 vs. grapple, 28 vs. grapple by humanoids)
Feats Greater Grapple, Improved Grapple, Power Attack
Skills Intimidate +7, Perception +2
Languages Common, Terran
SQ clever wrestler

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Clever Wrestler (Ex)

An antaeus gains a +2 circumstance bonus to his CMB and CMD on grapple combat maneuvers against humanoids.

He does not gain the grappled condition when grappling a Large or smaller humanoid, and he can grapple two Medium or smaller humanoids simultaneously. He must make a separate grapple check to maintain the grapple on each creature.

Counter-Throw (Ex)

When another creature attempts a bull rush, drag, grapple, overrun, or trip combat maneuver against an anteaus, as an immediate action he can attempt a combat maneuver check to bull rush or trip the attacker, resolving this maneuver before the attacker resolves theirs. If the attacker is tripped, the penalties for attacking from prone apply on their combat maneuver.

If the attacker is bull rushed farther away from the antaeus than their reach, their combat maneuver automatically fails. When using this ability, the antaeus need not move with the attacker to bull rush them more than 5 feet, and he can push the target away in any horizontal direction he wishes.

Gaea’s Strength (Su)

As long as an antaeus is in contact with the earth, their Strength and Constitution scores are increased by 4 (included in their stats). This feature functions if they stand on earth, stone, sand, or mud; even a wooden or stone floor of a building or street is sufficient as long as they are in contact with the actual ground.

Gaea’s Vitality (Su)

As long as an antaeus is in contact with the earth (see Gaea’s strength) they gain regeneration 20. An opponent can forcibly lift an antaeus off the ground by beating their CMB by 5 or more on a grapple check if they are the same size as the antaeus, or by beating their CMB if they are larger.

Sucker Punch (Ex)

If an antaeus confirms a critical hit or reduces a creature to 0 hit points or fewer with his slam attack, he can make an additional slam attack as a swift action against a creature he threatens, dealing 2d8+6 points of bludgeoning damage on a hit. He cannot grab an opponent he strikes with a sucker punch.

ECOLOGY

Environment any temperate land
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

An antaeus is a hulking humanoid, typically with dark skin and long, shaggy hair and beard, that love wrestling. They tend to avoid open battles but look for opportunities to challenge enemies to a one-on-one wrestling match, sometimes for stakes of gold but more often with life and death on the line. They claim a divine lineage to Mother Earth herself, Gaea, and use the skulls of enemies they crush with their mighty thews to lay the foundation of shrines or temples in the name of their divine parent or parents. They often waylay travelers, challenging them to feats of strength in exchange for free passage or even a reward. In battle, they tend to focus on a single opponent, locking them up with their grappling prowess until they submit, fall unconscious, or die. An antaeus is the size of a tall, broad man, usually close to or over 7 feet in height and covered in muscles, often oiling their skin to emphasize their physique.
